simple.title: River levels from space, with nearby rainfall context
simple.whatChanged: Between the captured satellite overpasses, observed water-surface elevation spanned 10.56 m at this reach. This is not a continuous-time rise or flood-stage estimate.
simple.where: SWOT SWORD reach 74267300251 (Ohio River near Louisville); POWER grid-point sample near Louisville (38.2527,-85.7585). Not necessarily upstream watershed precipitation.
simple.nextStep: Check local gauges, upstream watershed rain and official flood bulletins before responding to an event.
